Brown butter oat cookies

These cookies are crisp at the edge and chewy in the middle, and the butter does most of the work.

Ingredients

  • 170 g butter
  • 150 g light brown sugar
  • 1 egg
  • 120 g flour
  • 150 g rolled oats
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • A pinch of salt

Method

  1. Melt the butter in a pan until it foams and smells of toast. Cool for ten minutes.
  2. Whisk in the sugar and the egg.
  3. Fold in the flour, oats, baking soda and salt.
  4. Scoop onto a lined tray and bake at 180 C for twelve minutes.
